filament_notes:
• temp: honestly, not too much difference in 250°..230°. Not a lot of stringing in higher temperatures. 230° has no stringing and 235° has very small string of ≈2mm in length. Overhang looked best at 235° though.
• max flow rate: 21.5 rate seems around where artifacts show. For safety set to 20.
• pressure advance: best seems to be between .06 and .07, i.e. 0.065
• flow ratio: 1-0.05=0.95 showed best result
• retraction appears okay since 0.1mm, set 0.2mm for the safe case
name: PETG-CF KINGROON, 0.4nzl
